proposal.lede: This is what we proposed. If anything changes, we talk.

referral.lede: You came in through a referral link. You can have your own and share it too.
referral.wantWebBody: See the plans and their fixed price.

business.lede: Pick the plan closest to what you need and I will prepare the proposal.
business.packLine: {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} · from {price}

company.lede: My CV, a 20-minute call and the work I have done, by hand.

blog.lede: You came from a blog guide. You can go back to it or see what else there is.

neutral.lede: Two paths depending on what you are looking for.
neutral.projectBody: A website, a shop or an app: see how I work and what it costs.
neutral.talkTitle: I want to get to know you
neutral.talkBody: To collaborate, to hire or just to talk.

empty.tasksBody: When Jose adds tasks for your project, you will see them here.

tasks.lede: What needs doing on your project and who has the ball.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: No comments on this task yet.

form.label: Write a comment
form.help: Jose will see it. Up to 4000 characters.
form.invalid: Write a comment of 1 to 4000 characters.
form.failed: We could not send the comment. Please try again.

files.lede: The files of your project: what you send me and what I deliver.
files.emptyBody: Upload logos, texts or photos here, and you will also see what Jose shares with you.
files.downloadError: We could not prepare the download. Please try again.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.label: File
upload.help: Images, PDF, text, CSV, ZIP or Office. Up to 25 MB.
upload.notAllowed: That file type is not accepted. Try an image, PDF, text, CSV, ZIP or Office file.
upload.failed: We could not upload the file. Please try again.

plan.lede: What you hired, the extras of your project and how to extend it.
plan.weeks: {count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} of work
plan.upgradeLede: Move to a higher plan (you pay the list difference) or add extras.
plan.requested: Request sent. Jose will review it and answer you.
plan.pending: You have a pending request: {summary}. Jose will answer soon; until then another one cannot be sent.

upgrade.lede: Pick a higher plan, extras or both. The price below is the list price; Jose confirms before starting.
upgrade.pendingBlocked: You already have a pending request. When Jose resolves it you can send another.
upgrade.totalHelp: List difference between plans plus the extras. No extra discounts.
upgrade.nothing: Pick a higher plan or at least one extra.
upgrade.noOptions: There is no higher plan or extra available for you.

errors.nothing: Pick a higher plan or at least one extra.
errors.notAnUpgrade: That combination is not a valid upgrade for your plan.
errors.alreadyPending: You already have a pending request. Wait for Jose to resolve it.
errors.failed: We could not send the request. Please try again.

referrals.lede: If you know someone who needs a website or an app, share your link. If they end up hiring, you earn.
referrals.failed: We could not create your link. Please try again.
referrals.getBody: It is free and personal. It is built from your name and a unique code.
referrals.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically: the link is selected so you can copy it.

rules.client: If you are already a client: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of free maintenance for each client who hires.
rules.standard: If you are not a client: {percent}% of the first purchase, excluding VAT.
rules.premium: Premium referrer: {percent}% of the first purchase, excluding VAT.

referrals.rulesNote: The first purchase of the client who arrives with your link counts. Jose tells you when he pays it.
referrals.leadsEmptyBody: When someone arrives with your link and asks for a proposal, you will see it here, without their contact details.
referrals.rewardsEmptyBody: They appear when a referral ends in an order.
referrals.rewardMonths: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of maintenance

stories.lede: Tell me what you want your site to do in the form «As a… I want… so that…». Jose reviews them, tells you how many hours they take, and the ones that fit become your tasks.

empty.title: You have not proposed any story yet
empty.body: A story is one thing you want your site to do, told in three sentences with a list of what it must meet. Here is one:

story.title: See how my order is going
story.so_that: know when to pick it up
story.criteriaOne: I see whether it is received, being prepared or ready
story.criteriaTwo: I get a notice when it is ready

next.heading: What happens now
next.proposed: Jose will review it and tell you whether it fits and how many hours it takes. We will let you know when he decides.
next.accepted: It is accepted. Jose will turn it into a task of your project and you will see it under Tasks.
next.acceptedTask: It is accepted and already a task of your project: that is where you will see its progress.
next.rejected: Jose has left it out for now. The reason is above; if you like, propose another one with a different approach.

form.label: Propose a story
form.title: Title
form.titleHelp: A short name, for example «Book orders for pickup».
form.asHelp: Who you are in this story, for example «regular customer of the bakery».
form.wantHelp: What you want to be able to do.
form.criteriaHelp: How we will know it is done right. Optional, up to {max}.
form.max: You have reached the maximum of {max} criteria.
form.sent: Story sent. Jose will review it.
form.failed: We could not send the story. Please try again.
form.intro: Fill in the three sentences and, if you like, note how we will know it is done right. Jose will see it as soon as you send it.
